turns.question: How much less budget did the search campaign have left at the end of September 2026 than at the end of August 2026, using each month's last snapshot?
turns.answer: The search channel's campaigns had 4,305.00 EUR of budget left at the end of August 2026 (last snapshot per campaign) and 2,130.00 EUR at the end of September 2026, so September ended with less; the semantic layer returned these two figures and I did not compute the difference myself. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
